meetings.headline: Cemetery Commission reviewed the level-funded FY23 cemetery budget and questioned overtime that doubled in FY21.
meetings.summary: The Cemetery Commission heard the DPW director walk through the level-funded cemetery budget, with members pressing on the supervisor overtime line that ran well over in FY21. They discussed routing the Saturday burial family charge to overtime and the plan to start the North Cemetery hedge work with a trial section. Minutes of two December meetings were taken up and the meeting adjourned.

budget_items.topic: Cemetery budget: personnel and purchase of services structure
budget_items.what_was_said: The DPW director explained the cemetery budget has two sections, personnel and purchase of services, and walked through it line by line.
Salary rises under the DPW union contract negotiated starting fiscal year 22; a member asked whether the raise was across the board.
Budgeted historically at a fixed amount, went over in FY21, and is being held level because current spending is well under it.
Both are contractual; the supervisor is newly eligible for longevity pay.
Kept level; covers about 19 weeks of two seasonal workers, more than originally budgeted.
Total for the personnel section stated.
Four lines held level: purchase of service, uniform allowance, fuel, and supplies, since the new lines have not completed a year and are under budget.
figures_as_heard: twenty two thousand two hundred dollars

budget_items.what_was_said: Total is a small increase over last year driven by salaries; DPW director later said the cemetery is level funded.
figures_as_heard: a hundred thousand one hundred and fifteen dollars and 88 cents
two or three thousand dollar increase

budget_items.what_was_said: A member asked about the overtime line being overspent with a transfer from another cemetery line; the director found FY21 was over by the stated amount.
Prior years' overtime ranged from a few hundred dollars to about two thousand, with FY20 and FY21 higher.
The chair suggested the family charge for Saturday burials, which goes to the town, could be directed to the overtime account; the director will ask the town accountant.

budget_items.topic: Hedge trimming project at North Cemetery
budget_items.what_was_said: The commission wants to fund the hedge work from the purchase of service line, starting with a trial section before awarding the whole contract.

budget_items.topic: Purchase of service and supplies balances
budget_items.what_was_said: Roughly half or more of both lines are used, leaving a few thousand dollars in each.
A member estimated the overtime overspend equates to a large number of hours at the supervisor's rate and questioned it.
The chair said the commission must find out what remains of last year's appropriation to plan this year's.

decisions.decision: The DPW director will ask the town accountant (Karen) whether the Saturday burial charge can be routed to the cemetery overtime account.
Agreed to continue the plan to have a contractor trim a first section of hedges at North Cemetery as a trial, using the purchase of service line.
Chair to draft the commission's town report submission and find the remaining appropriation; next meeting in January or early February.
